smarttrack.title: SmartTrack Application
smarttrack.desc: A real-time school transport tracking system with dedicated apps for parents, drivers, and a Vue.js admin dashboard.
smarttrack.overview: SmartTrack is a real-time school transport tracking system designed to ensure safe and transparent travel for students.
detailsParagraphs: I developed the mobile applications using Flutter, creating dedicated interfaces for both drivers and parents, while the admin dashboard was built with Vue.js to manage and monitor transport activities efficiently.

The backend was developed in Node.js, featuring robust APIs and real-time event handling. Authentication was implemented using Firebase OTP via RCS and SMS fallback, ensuring secure and reliable access for all user types.

SmartTrack also includes a smart notification system — when a driver starts the school route, parents receive instant alerts, keeping them informed in real-time. Data such as trip start time, student pickups, and route progress are synced continuously across devices for complete visibility and peace of mind.
The system was designed with scalability, responsiveness, and user experience in mind, providing a reliable solution for school administrators and parents alike.

online-learning.title: Online Learning & Course Platform
online-learning.desc: A mobile-based learning platform allowing students to browse, purchase recorded video courses, single videos, or subscriptions securely via Razorpay.
online-learning.overview: A mobile-based online learning platform designed to allow students to access recorded courses, purchase individual video content or complete courses, and manage their subscriptions securely.
detailsParagraphs: I developed the mobile application using Flutter, providing students with an intuitive platform to browse, purchase, and access online learning content. The application supports recorded video courses uploaded and managed by administrators, allowing students to access purchased content directly from their accounts.

The platform provides flexible purchasing options, enabling students to purchase individual videos, specific course levels, complete courses, or subscription-based access depending on the content offering.

The backend was developed using Node.js, with RESTful APIs responsible for user management, course and video management, content access control, subscriptions, and payment processing. MongoDB was used to efficiently manage application data, including users, courses, videos, purchases, and subscription information.

Razorpay was integrated as the payment gateway to provide secure online payment processing. I also implemented Razorpay webhooks to reliably handle payment status updates and ensure that successful transactions are accurately reflected in the user's course or subscription access.

The application was designed with scalability, secure content access, and a smooth learning experience in mind, providing students with a convenient way to access structured online educational content while giving administrators control over course and video management.
